# Brand images

`readme-light.svg`, `readme-dark.svg` and `og.svg` are the sources for `readme-light.png` and `readme-dark.png` (README banner for GitHub light and dark themes, 2560x1280), `social.png` (GitHub social preview, `readme-light.svg` at 1280x640; `og.svg` is the same artwork at 1200x630, uploaded manually in GitHub Settings > Social preview) and `../../public/static/og-img.png` (og:image and twitter:image, 1200x630), as listed in `brand.config.json`. Render them with `npm run brand:images` (`node .github/brand/render.mjs`); `npm run brand:images:check` (`--check`) re-renders in memory and exits 1 if any source or output is stale. The fonts are Catamaran, Cabin and Roboto Mono under the SIL OFL 1.1 (license texts in `fonts/`), vendored with `render.mjs`, `embed-fonts.mjs` and `tokens.json` from the marcopontili.com repo-brand kit; do not edit the kit files here. The window mock in the readme banners uses the fonts md2pdf renders on Windows, via open stand-ins: Selawik for Segoe UI and Inconsolata for Consolas (SIL OFL 1.1, `fonts/OFL-Selawik.txt`, `fonts/OFL-Inconsolata.txt`). They are inlined between the `@app-fonts` markers, outside the kit's `@fonts` block.
